Mappings.Name: Altitude gauge (BMS)
Mappings.Notes: 'aauz' is BMS's AAU barometric altimeter reading (feet, from the secondary FalconSharedMemoryArea2 block) - the closest real equivalent to a cockpit altimeter. There is no direct 'AltitudeMslFt' field in BMS's shared memory; 'z' (ownship Down, Ft, primary block) is the raw sim-coordinate alternative if you'd rather derive MSL altitude yourself (negate it). Scale 0.1 here packs 0-6550 (x10 ft) into a UInt16 - adjust to taste.

Mappings.Name: Master caution light (BMS)
Mappings.Notes: 'lightBits_MasterCaution' is bit 0 of BMS's lightBits word (left eyebrow master caution lamp), decoded automatically by the app's built-in Falcon4 field table - see Falcon4NativeFieldMapBuilder in the source. As with every signal in this profile, sanity-check it against the Live Telemetry tab before wiring real hardware.

Mappings.Name: EXAMPLE - DCS airspeed (fill in real DCS-BIOS address first)
Mappings.Notes: Disabled by default - add a matching entry to config/dcs-bios-fields.sample.json with the real address for your aircraft before enabling.

Mappings.Name: Gear handle switch -> BMS
Mappings.Notes: CommandName 'GearHandle' must exist in config/falcon4-keybindings.sample.json, bound to the same key BMS has assigned to Gear Handle.

Mappings.Name: EXAMPLE - Master arm switch -> DCS (fill in real DCS-BIOS control name first)
EXAMPLE - CANopen node 1 TPDO1 byte 0 bit 0 -> BMS
Mappings.Notes: Disabled by default - only relevant if you've ticked 'Enable CANopen' and your STM32 node speaks CANopen (see README 'CANopen support'). CanId 385 = 0x181 = TPDO1 for node ID 1 (0x180 + 1), the predefined-connection-set COB-ID a CANopen node uses to transmit its first PDO - no different from any other CanToSim row otherwise. Re-target ByteOffset/BitOffset/CommandName to whatever your firmware actually packs into that PDO.
